summary: Teamshares Inc. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting entry into a Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement and concurrent closing of a $222.75 million private offering of newly designated Series A Perpetual Non-Voting Non-Convertible Preferred Stock. The company sold 225,000 shares at $990 per share, with a $1,000 per share liquidation preference, to purchasers affiliated with a greater-than-10% common stockholder. The company may issue up to $75 million additional liquidation preference on the same terms. The Series A is perpetual, non-voting, and non-convertible, with terms detailed in the filed Certificate of Designations.
